title: C16 Velka sabotaz
prompt: Wide night shot of a dark mining fortress with wooden scaffolding, a crane and a mine entrance full of blue magic crystals, huge explosions of bright orange chaos fire tear through both the crystal mine and the stone quarry at once, the scaffolding and crane collapse, blue crystal shards and stone blocks fly through the air, crackling orange lightning, thick black smoke and embers. No people. Background: dark grey-black night sky lit orange by fire. Palette: black, charcoal, bright orange, a few blue crystal accents. No text.

title: C20 Prazdna mysl
prompt: A huge glowing ring of bright orange chaos energy shaped like the folds of a brain floating in darkness, its centre is an empty pitch-black void, glowing orange chaos runes swirl around the ring, many playing cards with plain dark backs are sucked into the black void and crumble into orange ash and sparks, a thin trail of orange smoke flows down from the ring, crackling orange lightning. No people. Background: deep cold dark teal and black, strong contrast of glowing orange chaos against cold dark teal. No text, no symbols on the cards.

title: C39 Velky zmatek
prompt: A giant whirlwind of bright orange chaos fire tearing through a ruined grey town under a stormy sky, the whirlwind sweeps up hundreds of flying playing cards, torn black banners, planks and debris and scatters them everywhere, crackling orange lightning inside the vortex, a swirl of cold blue magic sparks at the top of the vortex. No people. Background: grey stormy clouds and cold mist. Palette: grey, slate, bright orange, a touch of electric blue. No text.

title: C12 Anarchie
prompt: Medium shot of a ruined royal throne hall, the great golden throne is toppled on its side and burning in bright orange chaos flames, a golden crown lies dented on the cracked floor, torn royal banners burn and fall from the walls, broken statues, overturned treasure chests with spilled coins, crackling orange lightning, embers and smoke. title: C33 Kradez identity
prompt: Two ornate venetian masquerade masks floating in darkness and swapping places around each other in a spiral of bright orange chaos energy, the first mask is white porcelain with gold trim, the second mask is black lacquer with silver trim, each one half-melting into the other's colours, shards of a broken ornate mirror float around them reflecting the masks, crackling orange lightning, orange sparks.
